dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yeah, don't worry about me, I'm very adaptable.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Once, when my old man and I were pursuing the Wild Hunt to the northern lands, we accidentally stumbled into a Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: There were countless monsters inside. The veteran Ratniki and I fought for three days and nights before we finally found the exit and retreated.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And despite all that, I managed to sneak naps in between enemy attacks.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: My old man said he thought I was scared stiff, seeing as how I'd fallen asleep before my eyes even closed, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But here, I don't have to constantly keep an ear out for distant alarms, or be worried if the enemy will suddenly attack all night.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I can get a good night's sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Only problem is... Well, you've put me out of a job.

choices.text: Then get the rest you deserve.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Easy for you to say, but now that I can suddenly just relax, I feel strangely empty inside.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: And I can't help but wonder if I'll have trouble readjusting to the rhythm of a life of war.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't you have anything you want to do?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Now that I think about it, I hone my combat skills to protect everyone, and study cooking to make food for everyone.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: ...I can't think of a single thing I do just for myself...

choices.text: Then let's start thinking about it now, eh?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Yeah. Sounds like a good call.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Well then, I'll treat your suggestion as my next "job".

choices.text: Then let's go make some new friends, shall we?
Don't even think about work while you're here.
